specialist_role: Koine Greek, textual, translation, and quotation-speaker specialist

read_scope: direct pinned WEB Galatians USFM text and coordinates

decision_policy: Literary seams are proposed from discourse, epistolary, syntactic, lexical-recurrence, citation, and paragraph evidence. All evidence is non-authorizing; every unit and hot-zone judgment is LOW and deferred.
canonical_coordinate_note: The proposal preserves the exact ordered WEB coordinate substrate Gal.1.1 through Gal.6.18: 149 of 149 coordinates, no gaps, duplicates, overlaps, additions, or remapping.

hardest_seams.note: Loyalty questions give way to disclosure thesis.
Immediate response yields to first ἔπειτα stage.
Judean reception closes before later ἔπειτα ascent.
Narrative direct-address onset continues into a disputed speech/argument extent.
First-person argument closes before vocative diatribe.
Redemption-purpose sequence yields to human analogy.
Promise-priority inference yields to Τί οὖν question.
Scripture-confinement answer yields to Πρὸ τοῦ δέ temporal exposition.
Heir conclusion continues conceptually into Λέγω δέ analogy.
Apprehension yields to personal imperative appeal.
Parental anguish yields to renewed diatribal address.
Allegory conclusion and freedom imperative are tightly linked.
Reciprocal warning yields to Λέγω δέ Spirit-walk command.
Corporate prohibitions yield to vocative restoration case.
Doing-good conclusion yields to autograph notice.
Blessing formula yields to final personal marks appeal.
